articles.summary: Dr. Melissa Briones joined theMednet in 2021, attracted by its extensive reach and the opportunity to make a broader impact in the medical field. As Medical Director, she leads teams across multiple specialties, including rheumatology, dermatology, pulmonology, allergy and immunology, gastroenterology, and hepatology.
